scripts.check:web: node scripts/test-unfollow-ui.mjs && npm --workspace web run lint
scripts.//check:deep: The everything lane, run before a release: the parser fixtures and the whole web lane (its unfollow-UI contract test, then oxlint). It exists so web's `lint` is reachable from a gate lane by name - the Architect's verification-coverage-reachability check reads package.json lanes, not workflows, so CI's own lint step does not count as its gate.
scripts.check:deep: npm run check && npm run check:web
scripts.test: node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs" && npm run check && npm run check:web
